name: Toxicology and Cancer Biology PhD
detailsNote: Available official requirements; older handbook conditions and undated dates qualified. Admission model omitted if not established.

english.note: Central minimum. US accredited degree or official transcript/direct registrar attestation confirming sole English instruction can satisfy proficiency. DET may be evaluated by ESL professional. Program may set higher standard.

applicationFee.note: Domestic fee 65. Conditional waiver for US military veterans or spouses/dependents with qualifying benefits documentation. No explicit citizenship rule stated; international applicants must confirm qualification. No general hardship waiver established.

requirements.note: Appropriate accredited science degree and GPA at least 3.0. Direct PhD application independent from IBS. Personal research/goals statement, CV; optional research paper. Three two-month first-year rotations before mentor selection.

funding.note: First-year department rotation support, then PI support. Undated current minimum$30,000/year plus required/recommended-course tuition and health insurance; confirm future offer.
